capabilities: insert column layouts via context menu or command palette
define column widths with YAML ratios
resize columns by dragging a divider
style columns with borders, colors and text alignment
extras: Nested columns and column background images are listed as future work, not current features.
problem: Obsidian notes are single-column documents with no built-in way to place content side by side in customizable, resizable columns.
summary: Column-layout plugin that renders resizable multi-column sections in notes from a markdown code-block syntax, with width ratios and per-column styling.
